lines.he: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה, וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
lines.tl: Vay'chal Elohim bayom hash'vi-i m'lachto asher asah, vayishbot bayom hash'vi-i mikol m'lachto asher asah
lines.en: On the seventh day God finished the work that had been undertaken: [God] ceased on the seventh day from doing any of the work.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ, כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת
lines.tl: Vay'varech Elohim et yom hash'vi-i vay'kadeish oto, ki vo shavat mikol m'lachto asher bara Elohim la-asot
lines.en: And God blessed the seventh day and declared it holy—having ceased on it from all the work of creation that God had done.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְרָצָה בָנוּ, וְשַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן הִנְחִילָנוּ, זִכָּרוֹן לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית, כִּי הוּא יוֹם תְּחִלָּה לְמִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ, זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם, כִּי בָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ וְאוֹתָנוּ קִדַּשְׁתָּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְשַׁבַּת קָדְשְׁךָ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן הִנְחַלְתָּנוּ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam, asher kid'shanu b'mitzvotav v'ratzah vanu, v'Shabbat kodsho b'ahavah uv'ratzon hinchilanu, zikaron l'ma-asei v'reishit, ki hu yom t'chilah l'mikra-ei kodesh, zeicher litzi-at Mitzrayim, ki vanu vacharta v'otanu kidashta mikol ha-amim v'Shabbat kodsh'cha b'ahavah uv'ratzon hinchaltanu
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and was pleased with us. And His holy Sabbath, with love and pleasure, He gave us for a heritage, a commemoration of the work of creation. For this day is the first of the days of holy convocations commemorating the exodus from Egypt. For us have You chosen and us have You sanctified from among all the peoples. And Your holy Sabbath with love and pleasure You gave us for a heritage.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עַל כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּשָׁכְבֵנוּ וּבְקוּמֵנוּ נָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ וְנִשְׂמַח בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Al kein Adonai Eloheinu b'shachveinu uv'kumeinu nasiach b'chukecha v'nismach b'divrei toratecha uv'mitzvotecha l'olam va-ed
lines.en: Therefore, Adonai, our God, when we lie down and when we rise, we will discuss Your statutes, and rejoice in the words of Your Torah and in Your commandments forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי הֵם חַיֵּינוּ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֵינוּ וּבָהֶם נֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה
lines.tl: Ki heim chayeinu v'orech yameinu uvahem nehgeh yomam valaylah
lines.en: For they are our life and they lengthen our days, and on them we will meditate day and night.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְאַהֲבָתְךָ אַל תָּסִיר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים
lines.tl: V'ahavatcha al tasir mimenu l'olamim
lines.en: [May] Your love never be removed from us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אוֹהֵב עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai oheiv amo Yisrael
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who loves His people Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Mi Chamocha
prayers.about: Who is like You: from the blessing after the Sh'ma (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, First Blessing after Shema (segs 1-2) (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 30: same Hebrew words (checked 11/07 from the page image; vowels not compared letter by letter).

lines.he: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא
lines.tl: Mi chamochah ba-eilim Adonai mi kamochah nedar bakodesh nora t'hilot osei fele
lines.en: “Who is like You among the mighty, Adonai! Who is like You? [You are] adorned in holiness, awesome in praise, performing wonders”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי משֶׁה זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ
lines.tl: Malchutcha ra-u vanecha bokei-a yam lifnei Moshe zeh eili anu v'amru
lines.en: Your children beheld Your sovereignty when You divided the sea before Moses.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Adonai yimloch l'olam va-ed
lines.en: “Adonai will reign forever and ever.”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ
lines.tl: V'ne-emar ki fadah Adonai et Yaakov ug'alo miyad chazak mimenu
lines.en: And it is said, “For Adonai has liberated Jacob and redeemed him from a hand, mightier than his.”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ga-al Yisrael
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai Who has redeemed Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Ma'ariv Aravim
prayers.about: Who brings on evening: the first blessing before the Sh'ma
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, First Blessing before Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 22: same Hebrew words (checked 11/07 from the page image; vowels not compared letter by letter).

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה פּוֹתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam asher bidvaro ma-ariv aravim b'chochmah poteiach sh'arim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, our God, King of the Universe, With His word He brings on evenings, with wisdom He opens the gates of heaven
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּבִתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ
lines.tl: Uvitvunah m'shaneh itim umachalif et haz'manim um'sadeir et hakochavim b'mishm'roteihem barakia kirtzono
lines.en: And with understanding changes the times and alternates the seasons, and arranges the stars in their watches, in the sky, according to His will.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי חשֶׁךְ וְחשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי אוֹר
lines.tl: Borei yom valaylah goleil or mip'nei choshech v'choshech mip'nei or
lines.en: He creates day and night, He rolls the light away from before darkness, and darkness from before light
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָיְלָה וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ
lines.tl: Uma-avir yom umeivi laylah umavdil bein yom uvein laylah Adonai tz'va-ot sh'mo
lines.en: He causes day to pass and brings night, and separates between day and night; Adonai of Hosts is His Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם תָּמִיד יִמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Eil chai v'kayam tamid yimloch aleinu l'olam va-ed
lines.en: The Almighty, [Who is] living and enduring will always reign over us forever and ever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai hama-ariv aravim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who brings on evening.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Hashkiveinu
prayers.about: Lay us down in peace: the evening prayer for protection
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Blessings of the Shema, Second Blessing after Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 32: Shabbat form, no second 'Uf'ros aleinu'; ends 'aleinu v'al Y'rushalayim'.
Line 1 English: Metsudah has no period after 'to life'.

lines.he: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיִּים
lines.tl: Hashkiveinu Adonai Eloheinu l'shalom v'ha-amideinu malkeinu l'chayim
lines.en: Adonai our God; make us lie down in peace, our King, raise us again to life
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְתַקְּנֵנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ
lines.tl: Uf'ros aleinu sukat sh'lomecha v'tak'neinu b'eitzah tovah mil'fanecha v'hoshi-einu l'ma-an sh'mecha
lines.en: Spread over us the shelter of Your peace, and direct us to better ourselves through Your good counsel; and deliver us for Your Name’s sake.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן
lines.tl: V'hagein ba-adeinu v'haseir mei-aleinu oyeiv dever v'cherev v'ra-av v'yagon
lines.en: Shield us, and remove from us enemies, pestilence, sword, famine and sorrow.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּפָנֵינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵינוּ וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ
lines.tl: V'haseir satan mil'faneinu umei-achareinu uv'tzeil k'nafecha tastireinu
lines.en: Remove the adversary from before us and from behind us, and shelter us in the shadow of Your wings.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ אָתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה
lines.tl: Ki eil shomreinu umatzileinu atah ki eil melech chanun v'rachum atah
lines.en: For, Almighty, You are our Protector and Rescuer, For, Almighty You are a gracious and merciful King.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם
lines.tl: Ush'mor tzeiteinu uvo-einu l'chayim ul'shalom mei-atah v'ad olam
lines.en: Guard our going out and our coming in for life and peace for now forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai haporeis sukat shalom aleinu v'al Y'rushalayim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who spreads the shelter of peace over us and over all His people, Israel and over Jerusalem.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
cbb: Ends 'aleinu v'al Y'rushalayim', without 'v'al kol amo Yisrael' (p. 32).

prayers.title: V'shamru
prayers.about: Keeping Shabbat: Exodus 31:16-17
prayers.he_src: Exodus 31:16-17 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: Torah text (Exodus 31:16-17). English: Contemporary Torah (CC-BY-NC).

lines.he: וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם
lines.tl: V'shamru v'nei Yisrael et haShabbat la-asot et haShabbat l'dorotam b'rit olam
lines.en: The Israelite people shall keep the sabbath, observing the sabbath throughout the ages as a covenant for all time:
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: בֵּינִי וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹת הִוא לְעֹלָם כִּי־שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְיָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ
lines.tl: Beini uvein b'nei Yisrael ot hi l'olam ki sheishet yamim asah Adonai et hashamayim v'et ha-aretz uvayom hash'vi-i shavat vayinafash
lines.en: It shall be a sign for all time between Me and the people of Israel. For in six days Adonai made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day [God] ceased from work and was refreshed.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

prayers.title: Avot v'Imahot
prayers.about: Our ancestors: the first blessing of the Amidah
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Patriarchs (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 36: Adonai s'fatai (line 1) matches.
CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 38 matches these lines (imahot, g'ulah, v'ezrat Sarah).

Hebrew base: Metsudah siddur (traditional). Reform wording added from Mishkan T'filah as I know it; please check each marked line, and the vowels of v'imoteinu and v'imahot (no Sefaria source for those two words).
English is the traditional Metsudah translation, so it doesn't mention the matriarchs. Add your own if you like.
The Ten Days of Repentance insert (Zochreinu) is left out.
Line 2, Reform change: Adds v'imoteinu (and our mothers). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 3, Reform change: Adds Elohei Sarah, Elohei Rivkah, Elohei Rachel v'Elohei Leah. Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 5, Reform change: Adds v'imahot (and mothers). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 5, Reform change: G'ulah (redemption) instead of go'el (a redeemer). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 7, Reform change: Adds v'ezrat Sarah (and Sarah's help). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
lines.tl: Adonai s'fatai tiftach ufi yagid t'hilatecha
lines.en: My Master, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְאִמּוֹתֵינוּ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu v'imoteinu
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, our God, and God of our fathers
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב אֱלֹהֵי שָׂרָה אֱלֹהֵי רִבְקָה אֱלֹהֵי רָחֵל וֵאלֹהֵי לֵאָה
lines.tl: Elohei Avraham Elohei Yitzchak v'Elohei Yaakov Elohei Sarah Elohei Rivkah Elohei Rachel v'Elohei Leah
lines.en: God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Adds Elohei Sarah, Elohei Rivkah, Elohei Rachel v'Elohei Leah.

lines.he: הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל
lines.tl: Ha-eil hagadol hagibor v'hanora eil elyon gomeil chasadim tovim v'konei hakol
lines.en: The Almighty, the Great, the Powerful, the Awesome, most high Almighty, Who bestows beneficent kindness, Who possesses everything
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת וּמֵבִיא גְאֻלָּה לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה
lines.tl: V'zocheir chasdei avot v'imahot umeivi g'ulah livnei v'neihem l'ma-an sh'mo b'ahavah
lines.en: Who remembers the piety of the Patriarchs, and Who brings a redeemer to their children’s children, for the sake of His Name, with love.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן
lines.tl: Melech ozeir umoshia umagein
lines.en: King, Helper, and Deliverer and Shield.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם וְעֶזְרַת שָׂרָה
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai magein Avraham v'ezrat Sarah
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Shield of Abraham.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: G'vurot
prayers.about: God's power: the second blessing of the Amidah
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Divine Might (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 40 says m'chayei meitim (the traditional wording), so the app follows it. Mishkan T'filah offers m'chayeih hakol.
Mashiv haruach umorid hagashem (line 2) is said only between Sukkot and Pesach; CBB has no summer morid hatal.

lines.he: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ
lines.tl: Atah gibor l'olam Adonai m'chayeh meitim atah rav l'hoshia
lines.en: You are mighty forever, my Master; You are the Resurrector of the dead the Powerful One to deliver us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מַשִּׁיב הָרוּחַ וּמוֹרִיד הַגֶּשֶׁם
lines.tl: Mashiv haruach umorid hageshem
lines.en: Causer of the wind to blow and of the rain to fall.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים
lines.tl: M'chalkeil chayim b'chesed m'chayeih meitim b'rachamim rabim
lines.en: Sustainer of the living with kindliness, Resurrector of the dead with great mercy
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר
lines.tl: Someich noflim v'rofei cholim umatir asurim um'kayeim emunato lisheinei afar
lines.en: Supporter of the fallen, and Healer of the sick, and Releaser of the imprisoned, and Fulfiller of His faithfulness to those who sleep in the dust.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה
lines.tl: Mi chamocha ba-al g'vurot umi domeh lach melech meimit um'chayeh umatzmiach y'shu-ah
lines.en: Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who can be compared to You? King Who causes death and restores life, and causes deliverance to sprout forth.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים
lines.tl: V'ne-eman atah l'hachayot meitim
lines.en: And You are faithful to restore the dead to life.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai m'chayeih hameitim
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Resurrector of the dead.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: K'dushat HaShem
prayers.about: God's holiness: the third blessing of the Amidah (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Holines of God's Name (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 42: same Hebrew words (checked 11/07 from the page image; vowels not compared letter by letter).
Evening form (no K'dushah). Ten Days ending (hamelech hakadosh) left out.

lines.he: אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה
lines.tl: Atah kadosh v'shimcha kadosh uk'doshim b'chol yom y'hal'lucha selah
lines.en: You are holy and Your Name is holy and holy beings praise You every day, forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ha-eil hakadosh
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, the Almighty, the Holy One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: K'dushat HaYom
prayers.about: The holiness of Shabbat: R'tzei vimnuchateinu (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Sanctity of the Day (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 43: same lines, opening 'Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu' without v'imoteinu, so the app follows it.
CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 42: Atah kidashta and Vay'chulu come first, then these lines. Atah kidashta isn't in the app yet.

lines.he: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵנוּ
lines.tl: Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu r'tzei vimnuchateinu
lines.en: Our God, and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ
lines.tl: Kad'sheinu b'mitzvotecha v'tein chelkeinu b'toratecha sab'einu mituvecha
lines.en: Sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת
lines.tl: V'sam'cheinu bishu-atecha, v'taheir libeinu l'avd'cha be-emet
lines.en: And gladden us with Your deliverance, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶׁךָ
lines.tl: V'hanchileinu Adonai Eloheinu b'ahavah uv'ratzon Shabbat kodshecha
lines.en: And give us as our inheritance, Adonai our God, in love and in pleasure Your holy Shabbat
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְיָנוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'yanuchu vah Yisrael m'kad'shei sh'mecha
lines.en: And may Israel rest thereon— the sanctifiers of Your Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai m'kadeish haShabbat
lines.en: Blessed are You Adonai, Sanctifier of Shabbat.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Shalom Rav
prayers.about: Abundant peace: the last blessing of the Amidah (evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Peace (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 48: same Hebrew words (checked 11/07 from the page image; vowels not compared letter by letter).
Ten Days insert (B'sefer chayim) left out. Ending: ham'vareich et amo Yisrael bashalom.

lines.he: שָׁלוֹם רָב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ תָּשִׂים לְעוֹלָם
lines.tl: Shalom rav al Yisrael am'cha tasim l'olam
lines.en: Bestow abundant peace upon Israel, Your people, forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶלֶךְ אָדוֹן לְכָל־הַשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Ki atah hu melech adon l'chol hashalom
lines.en: For You are King, the Master of all peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'tov b'einecha l'vareich et am'cha Yisrael b'chol eit uv'chol sha-ah bishlomecha
lines.en: And may it be good in Your sight to bless us and to bless Your people Israel, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ham'vareich et amo Yisrael bashalom
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Vay'chulu
prayers.about: Genesis 2:1-3: heaven and earth completed, and the seventh day
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Vay'chulu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 42 prints Vay'chulu in Hebrew inside the Amidah (Holiness of the Sabbath Day), after 'Atah kidashta'. Same words as here; not repeated after the Amidah.
Hebrew here: the Torah text as in the Metsudah siddur.

lines.he: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם
lines.tl: Vay'chulu hashamayim v'ha-aretz v'chol tz'va-am
lines.en: And the heavens and the earth were completed and [so were] all their hosts.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה, וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
lines.tl: Vay'chal Elohim bayom hash'vi-i m'lachto asher asah, vayishbot bayom hash'vi-i mikol m'lachto asher asah
lines.en: And God completed by the seventh day His work which He had done, and He abstained on the seventh day, from all His work which He had done.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ, כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת
lines.tl: Vay'varech Elohim et yom hash'vi-i vay'kadeish oto, ki vo shavat mikol m'lachto asher bara Elohim la-asot
lines.en: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it for on it He abstained from all His work which God had created to do.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Magen Avot
prayers.about: The Amidah in brief, said together after it (from Me'ein Sheva) (not in CBB's siddur)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Me'ein Sheva (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Not in CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach. Kept as in Mishkan T'filah (v'imahot, m'chayeih hakol).
Line 1, Reform change: Adds v'imahot: Magen avot v'imahot (shield of fathers and mothers). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.
Line 1, Reform change: M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih meitim. Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: מָגֵן אָבוֹת וְאִמָּהוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ, מְחַיֵּה הַכֹּל בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ
lines.tl: Magein avot v'imahot bidvaro, m'chayeih hakol b'ma-amaro
lines.en: Shield of [our] fathers with His word, Resurrector of the dead with His utterance
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Adds v'imahot: Magen avot v'imahot (shield of fathers and mothers).
M'chayeih hakol instead of m'chayeih meitim.

lines.he: הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין כָּמוֹהוּ, הַמֵּנִיחַ לְעַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ, כִּי בָם רָצָה לְהָנִיחַ לָהֶם
lines.tl: Ha-eil hakadosh she-ein kamohu, hameiniach l'amo b'yom Shabbat kodsho, ki vam ratzah l'haniach lahem
lines.en: The Almighty, the Holy One Who has no peer. He gives rest to His people on the day of His holy Shabbat for with them He was pleased to grant them rest.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְפָנָיו נַעֲבוֹד בְּיִרְאָה וָפַחַד, וְנוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מֵעֵין הַבְּרָכוֹת
lines.tl: L'fanav na-avod b'yir'ah vafachad, v'nodeh lishmo b'chol yom tamid mei-ein hab'rachot
lines.en: Before Him we will serve with fear and trepidation, and give thanks to His Name every day continuously, from the essence of the blessings.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְבָרֵךְ שְׁבִיעִי, וּמֵנִיחַ בִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְעַם מְדֻשְּׁנֵי עֹנֶג זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Eil hahoda-ot, adon hashalom, m'kadeish haShabbat um'vareich sh'vi-i, umeiniach bikdushah l'am m'dush'nei oneg zeicher l'ma-asei v'reishit
lines.en: Almighty of thanksgiving, Master of peace, Sanctifier of the Shabbat, Who blesses the seventh day and grants rest in sanctity to a people sated with delight— in commemoration of the work of creation.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Aleinu
prayers.about: Our duty to praise: the closing prayer
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Aleinu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 120-121: first paragraph (traditional 'shelo asanu', without 'shehem mishtachavim') and the V'ne-emar line. The middle lines are in English only, so they're left out.
Line 4, Reform change: Leaves out 'shehem mishtachavim lahevel varik umitpal'lim el el lo yoshia' (many traditional Ashkenazi siddurim also omit it). Confirm against Mishkan T'filah.

lines.he: עָלֵינוּ לְשַׁבֵּחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Aleinu l'shabeiach la-adon hakol lateit g'dulah l'yotzeir b'reishit
lines.en: It is our obligation to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה
lines.tl: Shelo asanu k'goyei ha-aratzot v'lo samanu k'mishp'chot ha-adamah
lines.en: That He has not made us like the nations of the lands, and has not positioned us like the families of the earth
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם
lines.tl: Shelo sam chelkeinu kahem v'goraleinu k'chol hamonam
lines.en: That He has not assigned our portion like theirs, nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
lines.tl: Va-anachnu kor'im umishtachavim umodim lifnei melech malchei ham'lachim hakadosh baruch hu
lines.en: But we bow, prostrate ourselves, and offer thanks before the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed is He
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
reform: Leaves out 'shehem mishtachavim lahevel varik umitpal'lim el el lo yoshia' (many traditional Ashkenazi siddurim also omit it).

lines.he: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד
lines.tl: V'ne-emar v'hayah Adonai l'melech al kol ha-aretz bayom hahu yihyeh Adonai echad ush'mo echad
lines.en: And it is said: And Adonai will be King over the whole earth; on that day Adonai will be One and His Name One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Mourner's Kaddish
prayers.about: Kaddish Yatom, in Aramaic: praise of God's name
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Mourner's Kaddish (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Aramaic. Ten Days inserts (l'eila l'eila) left out; the congregation's amein after line 1 is not shown.
CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 122: v'chayim, and Oseh shalom ends v'al kol Yisrael (no 'v'al kol yoshvei teiveil').
At CBB, does the whole congregation say it, or only mourners?

lines.he: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא
lines.tl: Yitgadal v'yitkadash sh'meih raba
lines.en: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בְּעָלְמָא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ
lines.tl: B'alma di v'ra chir'uteih v'yamlich malchuteih
lines.en: In the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
lines.tl: B'chayeichon uv'yomeichon uv'chayei d'chol beit Yisrael ba-agala uvizman kariv v'imru amein
lines.en: In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא
lines.tl: Y'hei sh'meih raba m'varach l'alam ul'almei almaya
lines.en: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
lines.tl: Yitbarach v'yishtabach v'yitpa-ar v'yitromam v'yitnasei v'yithadar v'yit'aleh v'yithalal sh'meih d'kudsha b'rich hu
lines.en: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He;
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְעֵלָּא מִן־כָּל־דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
lines.tl: L'eila min kol da-amiran b'alma v'imru amein
lines.en: Above all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן־שְׁמַיָּא וְחַיִּים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
lines.tl: Y'hei sh'lama raba min sh'maya v'chayim aleinu v'al kol Yisrael v'imru amein
lines.en: May there be abundant peace from heaven and a good life for us and for all Israel — and say Amein.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
lines.tl: Oseh shalom ya-aseh shalom aleinu v'al kol Yisrael v'imru amein
lines.en: He Who makes peace in His high heavens may He, in His mercy, make peace for us and for all Israel — and say Amein.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: L'cha Dodi (1)
prayers.about: Come, my beloved, to greet the bride: refrain and stanzas 1-2
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Lekha Dodi (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 14: refrain and stanzas 1, 2, 5 and 9 only. Hebrew and English here: Metsudah siddur.
The refrain is sung after every stanza.

lines.he: לְכָה דוֹדִי לִקְרַאת כַּלָּה, פְּנֵי שַׁבָּת נְקַבְּלָה
lines.tl: L'chah dodi likrat kalah, p'nei Shabbat n'kab'lah
lines.en: Come my Beloved Friend to greet the bride, let us welcome the Sabbath.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שָׁמוֹר וְזָכוֹר בְּדִבּוּר אֶחָד, הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ אֵל הַמְיוּחָד
lines.tl: Shamor v'zachor b'dibur echad, hishmi-anu eil ham'yuchad
lines.en: “Preserve” and “Remember” in a single utterance the One Almighty caused us to hear
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד, לְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאֶרֶת וְלִתְהִלָּה
lines.tl: Adonai echad ush'mo echad, l'sheim ul'tif'eret v'lit'hilah
lines.en: Adonai is One, and His Name is One; for fame, for glory, and for praise.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לִקְרַאת שַׁבָּת לְכוּ וְנֵלְכָה, כִּי הִיא מְקוֹר הַבְּרָכָה
lines.tl: Likrat Shabbat l'chu v'neilchah, ki hi m'kor hab'rachah
lines.en: To greet the Sabbath, come let us go for it is the source of blessing
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מֵרֹאשׁ מִקֶּדֶם נְסוּכָה, סוֹף מַעֲשֶׂה בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה תְּחִלָּה
lines.tl: Meirosh mikedem n'suchah, sof ma-aseh b'machashavah t'chilah
lines.en: From the very beginning, of old, it was appointed; last in creation, first in [God's] thought.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: L'cha Dodi (2)
prayers.about: Stanzas 5 and 9, ending Bo'i v'shalom
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Lekha Dodi (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 14: stanzas 5 and 9; everyone rises and turns to greet the Shabbat bride before stanza 9.
Last line English still says 'Sabbath Queen' (Metsudah); CBB's Hebrew ends 'bo'i chalah' twice.

lines.he: הִתְעוֹרְרִי, הִתְעוֹרְרִי, כִּי בָא אוֹרֵךְ קוּמִי אוֹרִי
lines.tl: Hit'or'ri, hit'or'ri, ki va oreich kumi ori
lines.en: Wake up! wake up! for your light has come, arise and shine.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עוּרִי עוּרִי שִׁיר דַּבֵּרִי, כְּבוֹד יְיָ עָלַיִךְ נִגְלָה
lines.tl: Uri uri shir dabeiri, k'vod Adonai alayich niglah
lines.en: Awaken! awaken! utter a song, The glory of Adonai is revealed upon you.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בּוֹאִי בְשָׁלוֹם עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ, גַּם בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְצָהֳלָה
lines.tl: Bo-i v'shalom ateret ba'lah, gam b'simchah uv'tzaholah
lines.en: Come in peace, crown of her husband, come rejoicing and with good cheer; amidst the faithful of the treasured people.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: תּוֹךְ אֱמוּנֵי עַם סְגֻלָּה, בֹּאִי כַלָּה, בֹּאִי כַלָּה
lines.tl: Toch emunei am s'gulah, bo-i chalah, bo-i chalah
lines.en: Come Bride, come Bride, come Bride, Shabbat Queen!
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Mizmor Shir (1)
prayers.about: Psalm 92, verses 1-6: a song for the Shabbat day
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Psalm 92 (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 16: verses 1-6, then 13-16. Hebrew and English: Metsudah siddur.

lines.he: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת
lines.tl: Mizmor shir l'yom haShabbat
lines.en: A Psalm, a song for the Shabbat day.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַייָ וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן
lines.tl: Tov l'hodot ladonai ul'zameir l'shimcha elyon
lines.en: It is good to thank Adonai, and sing praise to Your Name, Most High.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת
lines.tl: L'hagid baboker chasdecha ve-emunat'cha baleilot
lines.en: To relate Your kindliness in the morning, and Your faithfulness in the nights.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עֲלֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר
lines.tl: Alei asor va-alei navel alei higayon b'chinor
lines.en: Upon a ten-stringed instrument and lute, in meditation upon the harp.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְיָ בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן
lines.tl: Ki simachtani Adonai b'fa-olecha b'ma-asei yadecha aranein
lines.en: For You have given me joy, Adonai, with Your deeds, at the work of Your hands I sing joyously.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְיָ מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ
lines.tl: Ma gadlu ma-asecha Adonai m'od amku machsh'votecha
lines.en: How great are Your works, Adonai; how infinitely profound are Your thoughts.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Mizmor Shir (2)
prayers.about: Psalm 92, verses 13-16: the righteous flourish like a palm
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Psalm 92 (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 16: verses 13-16 (Tzadik katamar).
Line 1 starts a new block in CBB's siddur.

lines.he: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה
lines.tl: Tzadik katamar yifrach k'erez bal'vanon yisgeh
lines.en: The righteous will blossom like a date palm, like a cedar in Lebanon, he will grow tall.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְיָ בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ
lines.tl: Sh'tulim b'veit Adonai b'chatzrot Eloheinu yafrichu
lines.en: Planted in the House of Adonai, in the courtyards of our God they will blossom.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ
lines.tl: Od y'nuvun b'seivah d'sheinim v'ra-ananim yihyu
lines.en: They will still be fruitful in old age; they will be full of sap and freshness.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְיָ צוּרִי וְלֹא־עַוְלָתָה בּוֹ
lines.tl: L'hagid ki yashar Adonai tzuri v'lo avlatah bo
lines.en: To declare that Adonai is upright; He is my Stronghold; in Whom there is no injustice.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Adonai Malach (Psalm 93)
prayers.about: God reigns, robed in majesty (not in CBB's siddur)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Kabbalat Shabbat, Psalm 93 (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: Not in CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach (Friday night has Psalms 29, 92, 95-99). Kept from the traditional Kabbalat Shabbat.

lines.he: יְיָ מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְיָ עֹז הִתְאַזָּר
lines.tl: Adonai malach gei-ut laveish laveish Adonai oz hit'azar
lines.en: Adonai had begun His reign He has clothed Himself with majesty; Adonai has clothed Himself, He has girded Himself with strength.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט
lines.tl: Af tikon teiveil bal timot
lines.en: He has firmly established the world so that it cannot be moved.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה
lines.tl: Nachon kis'acha mei-az mei-olam atah
lines.en: Your throne stands firm from of old, You are from eternity.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְיָ נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם
lines.tl: Nas'u n'harot Adonai nas'u n'harot kolam yis'u n'harot dochyam
lines.en: The rivers have raised—Adonai— the rivers have raised their voice, the rivers raise their raging waves.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְיָ
lines.tl: Mikolot mayim rabim adirim mishb'rei yam adir bamarom Adonai
lines.en: More than the sound of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea Mighty on high, are You, Adonai.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נָאֲוָה־קֹּדֶשׁ יְיָ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים
lines.tl: Eidotecha ne-emnu m'od l'veit'cha na-avah kodesh Adonai l'orech yamim
lines.en: Your testimonies are extremely faithful, holiness is becoming to Your House, Adonai—for the length of days.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Ein Kamocha
prayers.about: Taking out the Torah: none like You
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Shabbat Torah Reading (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 104: same Hebrew words. Starts at Ein kamocha (no Atah hor'eita). Av harachamim here is the short verse, not the memorial prayer of the same name.
Hebrew: Siddur Sefard (Torat Emet, public domain); English: Metsudah (CC-BY).

lines.he: אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ
lines.tl: Ein kamocha va-Elohim Adonai v'ein k'ma-asecha
lines.en: There is none like You among gods, my master, and nothing like Your works.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים, וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
lines.tl: Malchutcha malchut kol olamim, umemshalt'cha b'chol dor vador
lines.en: Your kingship is the kingship for all worlds and Your dominion is in every generation.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ, יְיָ מָלָךְ, יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch l'olam va-ed
lines.en: Adonai is King, Adonai was King, Adonai will be King forever and ever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן, יְיָ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Adonai oz l'amo yitein, Adonai y'vareich et amo vashalom
lines.en: Adonai will give strength to His people Adonai will bless His people with peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אָב הָרַחֲמִים, הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן, תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם
lines.tl: Av harachamim, heitivah virtzoncha et Tziyon, tivneh chomot Y'rushalayim
lines.en: Father of compassion! Do good, as You see fit, to Zion. May You rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי בְךָ לְבַד בָּטָחְנוּ, מֶלֶךְ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא אֲדוֹן עוֹלָמִים
lines.tl: Ki v'cha l'vad batachnu, melech eil ram v'nisa adon olamim
lines.en: For in You alone do we trust, King, Almighty, Exalted and Uplifted, Master of worlds.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Vay'hi Binsoa
prayers.about: The ark opens; Sh'ma, Echad and Gadlu with the Torah in hand
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Shabbat Torah Reading (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 104 and 107: same Hebrew words. Sh'ma, Echad and Gadlu: the leader says each, the congregation repeats.
CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach prints (v'nora) in Echad: added on the High Holy Days, left out here.

lines.he: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר משֶׁה
lines.tl: Vay'hi binsoa ha-aron vayomer Moshe
lines.en: And whenever the Ark traveled Moses would say:
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: קוּמָה יְיָ וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ, וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ
lines.tl: Kumah Adonai v'yafutzu oyvecha, v'yanusu m'san'echa
lines.en: Rise, Adonai and let Your enemies be scattered, and those who hate You, flee before You.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה, וּדְבַר יְיָ מִירוּשָׁלָיִם
lines.tl: Ki miTziyon teitzei Torah, ud'var Adonai miY'rushalayim
lines.en: For from Zion will go forth the Torah, and the word of Adonai from Jerusalem.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ
lines.tl: Baruch shenatan Torah l'amo Yisrael bikdushato
lines.en: Blessed is He Who gave the Torah to His people Israel in His holiness.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ אֶחָד
lines.tl: Sh'ma Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad
lines.en: Hear Israel, Adonai is our God, Adonai is One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֶחָד הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ, קָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ
lines.tl: Echad hu Eloheinu, gadol adoneinu, kadosh sh'mo
lines.en: One is our God, great is our Master; holy is His Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: גַּדְּלוּ לַייָ אִתִּי, וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו
lines.tl: Gadlu ladonai iti, un'rom'mah sh'mo yachdav
lines.en: Declare the greatness of Adonai with me, and let us exalt His Name together.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: L'cha Adonai
prayers.about: The Torah procession: Yours, Adonai, is the greatness
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Shabbat Torah Reading (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 108: same Hebrew words. Sung as the Torah is carried around the room.

lines.he: לְךָ יְיָ הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַהוֹד
lines.tl: L'cha Adonai hag'dulah v'hag'vurah v'hatif'eret v'haneitzach v'hahod
lines.en: Yours, Adonai, is the greatness, the might, the glory, the victory, and the beauty
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי כֹל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ
lines.tl: Ki chol bashamayim uva-aretz
lines.en: For everything in heaven and on earth [is Yours]
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְךָ יְיָ הַמַּמְלָכָה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ
lines.tl: L'cha Adonai hamamlachah v'hamitnasei l'chol l'rosh
lines.en: Yours, Adonai, is the kingdom, and You are uplifted over all rulers.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: רוֹמְמוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא
lines.tl: Rom'mu Adonai Eloheinu v'hishtachavu lahadom raglav kadosh hu
lines.en: Exalt Adonai, our God and prostrate yourselves at His footstool, Holy is He.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: רוֹמְמוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ
lines.tl: Rom'mu Adonai Eloheinu v'hishtachavu l'har kodsho ki kadosh Adonai Eloheinu
lines.en: Exalt Adonai, Our God and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain for Adonai, our God, is holy.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: V'zot HaTorah
prayers.about: Lifting the Torah for all to see
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Hagbahah (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 113: same Hebrew words. Said as the Torah is lifted.

lines.he: וְזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר שָׂם מֹשֶׁה לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: V'zot haTorah asher sam Moshe lifnei b'nei Yisrael
lines.en: This is the Torah which Moses placed before the children of Israel
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עַל פִּי יְיָ בְּיַד מֹשֶׁה
lines.tl: Al pi Adonai b'yad Moshe
lines.en: At Adonai's command by the hand of Moses.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Haftarah blessings (after)
prayers.about: After the reading from the Prophets (CBB's short form)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Haftarah Blessings (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 114: CBB's short form. After the first part of the first blessing (ending emet vatzedek) it goes straight to Al haTorah; the Ne'eman, Rachem al Tziyon and Sam'cheinu blessings are left out.
Hebrew: Siddur Sefard (Torat Emet); English: Metsudah. The English of line 3 lacks a comma ('Divine Service for the Prophets').

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, צוּר כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים, צַדִּיק בְּכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam, tzur kol ha-olamim, tzadik b'chol hadorot
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, King of the Universe, Rock of all the worlds, Righteous in all generations
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן הָאוֹמֵר וְעוֹשֶׂה, הַמְדַבֵּר וּמְקַיֵּם שֶׁכָּל דְּבָרָיו אֱמֶת וָצֶדֶק
lines.tl: Ha-eil hane-eman ha-omeir v'oseh, ham'dabeir um'kayeim shekol d'varav emet vatzedek
lines.en: The Almighty, the Faithful One, Who says and does, Who speaks and fulfills, for all His words are true and right.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה וְעַל הַנְּבִיאִים וְעַל יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה
lines.tl: Al haTorah v'al ha-avodah v'al han'vi-im v'al yom haShabbat hazeh
lines.en: For the Torah, for the Divine Service for the Prophets, and for this Sabbath Day
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁנָּתַתָּ לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לִקְדֻשָּׁה וְלִמְנוּחָה לְכָבוֹד וּלְתִפְאָרֶת
lines.tl: Shenatata lanu Adonai Eloheinu likdushah v'limnuchah l'chavod ul'tif'aret
lines.en: Which You gave us, Adonai, our God, for holiness and for rest, for honor and for glory.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עַל הַכֹּל, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ וּמְבָרְכִים אוֹתָךְ, יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׁמְךָ בְּפִי כָּל חַי תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Al hakol, Adonai Eloheinu anachnu modim lach um'varchim otach, yitbarach shimcha b'fi kol chai tamid l'olam va-ed
lines.en: For all this, Adonai, our God, we thank You, and bless You; blessed be Your Name by the mouth of all the living continually forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai, m'kadeish haShabbat
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Sanctifier of the Sabbath.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Etz Chayim Hi
prayers.about: Returning the Torah to the ark: a tree of life
prayers.he_src: Psalms 148:13-14 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 118-119: same selection. Line 1 is Psalm 148:13 (first half), then Proverbs 4:2, 3:18, 3:17 and Lamentations 5:21.
Verses: Hebrew Miqra al pi ha-Masorah (Hashiveinu uses the read form v'nashuvah); English JPS 1917 (public domain), old-fashioned in places.

lines.he: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ
lines.tl: Y'hal'lu et sheim Adonai ki nisgav sh'mo l'vado
lines.en: Let them praise the name of Adonai, For His name alone is exalted
lines.en_src: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

lines.he: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם תּוֹרָתִי אַל־תַּעֲזֹבוּ
lines.tl: Ki lekach tov natati lachem Torati al ta-azovu
lines.en: For I give you a good taking; Forsake ye not my teaching.
lines.en_src: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

lines.he: עֵץ חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְתוֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר
lines.tl: Eitz chayim hi lamachazikim bah v'tomcheha m'ushar
lines.en: It is a tree of life to those who grasp to it, and those who support it are fortunate.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי נֹעַם וְכָל נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם
lines.tl: D'racheha darchei no-am v'chol n'tivoteha shalom
lines.en: Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם
lines.tl: Hashiveinu Adonai eilecha v'nashuvah chadeish yameinu k'kedem
lines.en: Turn Thou us unto Thee, Adonai, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
lines.en_src: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

prayers.title: Mah Tovu
prayers.about: Entering the sanctuary: how good are your tents, Jacob
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Ma Tovu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 52: same Hebrew words. Said on entering the sanctuary.
Hebrew and English: Metsudah siddur (weekday page; same text on Shabbat).

lines.he: מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Ma tovu ohalecha Yaakov mishk'notecha Yisrael
lines.en: How good are your tents, Jacob: your dwelling places, Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ
lines.tl: Va-ani b'rov chasd'cha avo veitecha
lines.en: As for me, through Your abundant kindness I will enter Your House
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ
lines.tl: Eshtachaveh el heichal kodsh'cha b'yir'atecha
lines.en: I will prostrate myself toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ
lines.tl: Adonai ahavti m'on beitecha um'kom mishkan k'vodecha
lines.en: Adonai, I love the Dwelling, Your House, and the place where Your glory resides.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְאֶכְרָעָה אֶבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי יְיָ עֹשִׂי
lines.tl: Va-ani eshtachaveh v'echra-ah evr'chah lifnei Adonai osi
lines.en: I will prostrate myself, and bow, I will kneel before Adonai, my Maker.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְיָ עֵת רָצוֹן
lines.tl: Va-ani t'filati l'cha Adonai eit ratzon
lines.en: May my prayer to You Adonai be at a favorable time
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ
lines.tl: Elohim b'rav chasdecha aneini be-emet yish'echa
lines.en: God, in the abundance of Your kindness answer me with the truth of Your deliverance.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Yotzer Or (1)
prayers.about: Morning creation: Former of light, Creator of darkness
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, First Blessing before Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 68: CBB's short Shabbat Yotzer Or. Lines 3-6 come from the Shabbat paragraph Hakol yoducha (Siddur Sefard text, public domain; same words in the Ashkenazi siddur).
Hebrew line 1-2: Metsudah. CBB leaves out El Adon, La'El asher shavat and the K'dushah of Yotzer.

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai Eloheinu melech ha-olam
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai our God, King of the Universe
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יוֹצֵר אוֹר וּבוֹרֵא חשֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם וּבוֹרֵא אֶת־הַכֹּל
lines.tl: Yotzeir or uvorei choshech oseh shalom uvorei et hakol
lines.en: Former of light, Creator of darkness, Maker of peace, Creator of all things.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הַכֹּל יוֹדוּךָ, וְהַכֹּל יְשַׁבְּחוּךָ, וְהַכֹּל יֹאמְרוּ אֵין קָדוֹשׁ כַּייָ
lines.tl: Hakol yoducha, v'hakol y'shab'chucha, v'hakol yomru ein kadosh kAdonai
lines.en: All will thank You, all will praise You, and all will proclaim: “There is none holy like Adonai.”
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הַכֹּל יְרוֹמְמוּךָ סֶּלָה, יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל
lines.tl: Hakol y'rom'mucha selah, yotzeir hakol
lines.en: All will exalt You, forever, Creator of all.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הָאֵל הַפּוֹתֵחַ בְּכָל יוֹם דַּלְתוֹת שַׁעֲרֵי מִזְרָח
lines.tl: Ha-eil hapoteiach b'chol yom daltot sha-arei mizrach
lines.en: The Almighty Who opens each day the doors of the gates of the east
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּבוֹקֵעַ חַלּוֹנֵי רָקִיעַ, מוֹצִיא חַמָּה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וּלְבָנָה מִמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתָּהּ
lines.tl: Uvokeia chalonei rakia, motzi chamah mim'komah ul'vanah mim'chon shivtah
lines.en: And pierces the windows of the firmament; Who brings the sun out of its place and the moon from its dwelling-place
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Yotzer Or (2)
prayers.about: Renewing creation every day; a new light on Zion
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Shema & Blessings (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 68-69: CBB skips 'u'meir la'olam kulo...' and 'Mah rabu ma'asecha', then ends with Or chadash and the blessing (p. 69).
Lines 1-5: Siddur Sefard Shabbat text; lines 6-7: Metsudah.

lines.he: הַמֵּאִיר לָאָרֶץ וְלַדָּרִים עָלֶיהָ בְּרַחֲמִים
lines.tl: Hamei-ir la-aretz v'ladarim aleha b'rachamim
lines.en: He illuminates the earth and those who dwell on it with compassion
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּבְטוּבוֹ מְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Uv'tuvo m'chadeish b'chol yom tamid ma-asei v'reishit
lines.en: And in His goodness renews every day, continually, the work of creation.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְּרֹמָם לְבַדּוֹ מֵאָז, הַמְּשֻׁבָּח וְהַמְּפֹאָר וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא מִימוֹת עוֹלָם
lines.tl: Hamelech ham'romam l'vado mei-az, ham'shubach v'ham'fo-ar v'hamitnasei mimot olam
lines.en: The King Who alone is exalted from then; Who is praised, glorified, and uplifted from the beginning of time.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ
lines.tl: Elohei olam b'rachamecha harabim racheim aleinu
lines.en: Eternal God— in Your abundant mercy, have compassion on us
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֲדוֹן עֻזֵּנוּ, צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּנוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵנוּ
lines.tl: Adon uzeinu, tzur misgabeinu, magein yish'einu, misgav ba-adeinu
lines.en: Master Who is our strength, Rock Who is our stronghold, Shield of our deliverance, [Be] a stronghold for us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אוֹר חָדָשׁ עַל־צִיּוֹן תָּאִיר וְנִזְכֶּה כֻלָּנוּ מְהֵרָה לְאוֹרוֹ
lines.tl: Or chadash al Tziyon ta-ir v'nizkeh chulanu m'heirah l'oro
lines.en: Shine a new light upon Zion, and may we all soon be privileged to [enjoy] its brightness.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ יוֹצֵר הַמְּאוֹרוֹת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai yotzeir ham'orot
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Former of the luminaries.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Ahavah Rabbah
prayers.about: Great love: the blessing of Torah before the morning Sh'ma
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Second Blessing before Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 70-71: same Hebrew words (the full traditional text).
Hebrew and English: Metsudah siddur (weekday page; same text on Shabbat).

lines.he: אַהֲבָה רַבָּה אֲהַבְתָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ חֶמְלָה גְדוֹלָה וִיתֵרָה חָמַלְתָּ עָלֵינוּ
lines.tl: Ahavah rabah ahavtanu Adonai Eloheinu chemlah g'dolah viteirah chamalta aleinu
lines.en: [With] unbounded love You have loved us Adonai, our God; [With] great and abundant pity have You pitied us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ בַּעֲבוּר אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבָּטְחוּ בְךָ וַתְּלַמְּדֵם חֻקֵּי חַיִּים כֵּן תְּחָנֵּנוּ וּתְלַמְּדֵנוּ
lines.tl: Avinu malkeinu ba-avur avoteinu shebatchu v'cha vat'lam'deim chukei chayim kein t'chaneinu ut'lam'deinu
lines.en: Our Father, our King! for the sake of our forefathers who trusted in You, and whom You taught statutes of life, so too, be gracious to us and teach us.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אָבִינוּ הָאָב הָרַחֲמָן הַמְרַחֵם רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לְהָבִין וּלְהַשְׂכִּיל
lines.tl: Avinu ha-av harachaman ham'racheim racheim aleinu v'tein b'libeinu l'havin ul'haskil
lines.en: Our Father, merciful Father, Who acts with compassion have compassion on us and put into our hearts to comprehend, and to be intellectually creative
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לִשְׁמֹעַ לִלְמֹד וּלְלַמֵּד לִשְׁמֹר וְלַעֲשׂוֹת וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי תַלְמוּד תּוֹרָתֶךָ בְּאַהֲבָה
lines.tl: Lishmoa lilmod ul'lameid lishmor v'la-asot ul'kayeim et kol divrei talmud toratecha b'ahavah
lines.en: To listen, to learn, and to teach, to preserve, to practice, and to fulfill all the words of instruction in Your Torah with love.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָאֵר עֵינֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וְדַבֵּק לִבֵּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'ha-eir eineinu b'toratecha v'dabeik libeinu b'mitzvotecha v'yacheid l'vaveinu l'ahavah ul'yir'ah et sh'mecha
lines.en: And enlighten our eyes in Your Torah, and cause our hearts to hold fast to Your commandments, and unify our hearts to love and fear Your Name
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְלֹא נֵבוֹשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא בָּטָחְנוּ נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ
lines.tl: V'lo neivosh l'olam va-ed ki v'sheim kodsh'cha hagadol v'hanora batachnu nagilah v'nism'chah bishu-atecha
lines.en: And may we never be put to shame, for in Your holy, great, and awesome Name— have we trusted; may we exult and rejoice in Your deliverance.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְתוֹלִיכֵנוּ קוֹמְמִיּוּת לְאַרְצֵנוּ
lines.tl: Vahavi-einu l'shalom mei-arba kanfot ha-aretz v'tolicheinu kom'miyut l'artzeinu
lines.en: And bring us to peace from the four corners of the earth and lead us upright to our land.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי אֵל פּוֹעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת אָתָּה וּבָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ מִכָּל־עַם וְלָשׁוֹן
lines.tl: Ki eil po-eil y'shu-ot atah uvanu vacharta mikol am v'lashon
lines.en: Because, You are the Almighty, Who performs acts of deliverance, and You have chosen us from among all peoples and tongues
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל סֶלָה בֶּאֱמֶת לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ וּלְיַחֶדְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה
lines.tl: V'keiravtanu l'shimcha hagadol selah be-emet l'hodot l'cha ul'yachedcha b'ahavah
lines.en: And You have brought us close to Your great Name, forever in truth; that we may give thanks to You, and proclaim Your Oneness, with love.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַבּוֹחֵר בְּעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבָה
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai habocheir b'amo Yisrael b'ahavah
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who chooses His people Yisrael with love.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: V'haya Im Shamoa (1)
prayers.about: The second paragraph of the Sh'ma: Deuteronomy 11:13-17
prayers.he_src: Deuteronomy 11:13-21 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 76 prints all of V'haya im shamoa (Deuteronomy 11:13-21), which many Reform siddurim leave out. Torah text, Contemporary Torah English.
Does CBB read it aloud or silently?

lines.he: וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעׇבְדוֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶם
lines.tl: V'hayah im shamoa tishm'u el mitzvotai asher anochi m'tzaveh etchem hayom l'ahavah et Adonai Eloheichem ul'ovdo b'chol l'vavchem uv'chol nafsh'chem
lines.en: If, then, you obey the commandments that I enjoin upon you this day, loving your God Adonai and serving [God] with all your heart and soul,
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר־אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ
lines.tl: V'natati m'tar artz'chem b'ito yoreh umalkosh v'asafta d'ganecha v'tiroshcha v'yitzharecha
lines.en: I will grant the rain for your land in season, the early rain and the late. You shall gather in your new grain and wine and oil—
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ
lines.tl: V'natati eisev b'sadcha livhemtecha v'achalta v'savata
lines.en: I will also provide grass in the fields for your cattle—and thus you shall eat your fill.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם
lines.tl: Hishamru lachem pen yifteh l'vavchem v'sartem va-avadtem Elohim acheirim v'hishtachavitem lahem
lines.en: Take care not to be lured away to serve other gods and bow to them.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וְחָרָה אַף־יְיָ בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת־יְבוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְיָ נֹתֵן לָכֶם
lines.tl: V'charah af Adonai bachem v'atzar et hashamayim v'lo yihyeh matar v'ha-adamah lo titein et y'vulah va-avadtem m'heirah mei-al ha-aretz hatovah asher Adonai notein lachem
lines.en: For Adonai’s anger will flare up against you, shutting up the skies so that there will be no rain and the ground will not yield its produce; and you will soon perish from the good land that Adonai is assigning to you.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

prayers.title: V'haya Im Shamoa (2)
prayers.about: Deuteronomy 11:18-21: on your heart, your hand, your doorposts
prayers.he_src: Deuteronomy 11:13-21 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 76: Deuteronomy 11:18-21.

lines.he: וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל־יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם
lines.tl: V'samtem et d'varai eileh al l'vavchem v'al nafsh'chem uk'shartem otam l'ot al yedchem v'hayu l'totafot bein eineichem
lines.en: Therefore impress these My words upon your very heart: bind them as a sign on your hand and let them serve as a symbol on your forehead,
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'limadtem otam et b'neichem l'dabeir bam b'shivt'cha b'veitecha uv'lecht'cha vaderech uv'shochb'cha uv'kumecha
lines.en: And teach them to your children—reciting them when you stay at home and when you are away, when you lie down and when you get up;
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ
lines.tl: Uch'tavtam al m'zuzot beitecha uvish'arecha
lines.en: And inscribe them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates—
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְיָ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ
lines.tl: L'ma-an yirbu y'meichem vimei v'neichem al ha-adamah asher nishba Adonai la-avoteichem lateit lahem kimei hashamayim al ha-aretz
lines.en: To the end that you and your children may endure, in the land that Adonai swore to your fathers to assign to them, as long as there is a heaven over the earth.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

prayers.title: Tzitzit
prayers.about: The third paragraph of the Sh'ma: Numbers 15:37-39 (continues with L'ma'an tizk'ru)
prayers.he_src: Numbers 15:37-39 (Miqra according to the Masorah, CC-BY-SA)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 78-79: Numbers 15:37-39, then L'ma'an tizk'ru (15:40-41), which you know from V'ahavta.
Torah text, Contemporary Torah English.

lines.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יְיָ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר
lines.tl: Vayomer Adonai el Moshe leimor
lines.en: Adonai said to Moses as follows:
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת
lines.tl: Dabeir el b'nei Yisrael v'amarta aleihem v'asu lahem tzitzit al kanfei vigdeihem l'dorotam v'natnu al tzitzit hakanaf p'til t'cheilet
lines.en: Speak to the Israelite people and instruct them to make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments throughout the ages; let them attach a cord of blue to the fringe at each corner.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

lines.he: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺת יְיָ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא־תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם
lines.tl: V'hayah lachem l'tzitzit ur'item oto uz'chartem et kol mitzvot Adonai va-asitem otam v'lo taturu acharei l'vavchem v'acharei eineichem asher atem zonim achareihem
lines.en: That shall be your fringe; look at it and recall all the commandments of Adonai and observe them, so that you do not follow your heart and eyes in your lustful urge.
lines.en_src: The Contemporary Torah, Jewish Publication Society, 2006

prayers.title: Mi Chamocha (morning)
prayers.about: At the sea: T'hilot l'El elyon to Tzur Yisrael
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Blessings of the Shema, Blessing after Shema (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 82: same Hebrew words, plus Miriam in line 2. CBB's English names Miriam; the Metsudah English here doesn't.
Hebrew and English: Metsudah siddur (weekday page; same text on Shabbat).

lines.he: תְּהִלּוֹת לְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּמְבֹרָךְ
lines.tl: T'hilot l'eil elyon baruch hu um'vorach
lines.en: Praises to the most high Almighty, blessed is He, and He is blessed.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מֹשֶׁה, מִרְיָם וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם
lines.tl: Moshe, Miriam uv'nei Yisrael l'cha anu shirah b'simchah rabah v'amru chulam
lines.en: Moses and the Children of Israel sang a song to You with great joy, and they all proclaimed:
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מִי כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא
lines.tl: Mi chamochah ba-eilim Adonai mi kamochah nedar bakodesh nora t'hilot osei fele
lines.en: Who is like You among the mighty, Adonai! Who is like You— [You are] adorned in holiness, awesome in praise, performing wonders!
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שִׁירָה חֲדָשָׁה שִׁבְּחוּ גְאוּלִים לְשִׁמְךָ עַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם
lines.tl: Shirah chadashah shib'chu g'ulim l'shimcha al s'fat hayam
lines.en: With a new song the redeemed people praised Your Name at the seashore!
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יַחַד כֻּלָּם הוֹדוּ וְהִמְלִיכוּ וְאָמְרוּ
lines.tl: Yachad kulam hodu v'himlichu v'amru
lines.en: All of them gave thanks in unison and proclaimed Your sovereignty and said:
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Adonai yimloch l'olam va-ed
lines.en: Adonai will reign forever and ever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל קוּמָה בְּעֶזְרַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפְדֵה כִנְאֻמֶךָ יְהוּדָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Tzur Yisrael kumah b'ezrat Yisrael uf'dei chin'umecha Y'hudah v'Yisrael
lines.en: Rock of Israel, arise to the aid of Israel, and liberate Judah and Israel as You promised.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: גֹּאֲלֵנוּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Go-aleinu Adonai tz'va-ot sh'mo k'dosh Yisrael
lines.en: Our Redeemer— ‘Adonai of hosts’ is His Name, the Holy One of Israel
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ga-al Yisrael
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who redeemed Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: K'dushah (1)
prayers.about: Holy, holy, holy: the morning K'dushah, said aloud together
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Kedushah (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 90: CBB's K'dushah joins the Shabbat morning text with lines from Musaf (Adir adirenu, Echad hu Eloheinu). Those two lines and 'Ani Adonai Eloheichem' are typed from CBB's page (no full-vowel source on Sefaria); English for them is my own draft.
Other lines: Metsudah siddur, weekday K'dushah (same words). CBB leaves out 'sheinit' in Echad hu Eloheinu.

lines.he: נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בָּעוֹלָם כְּשֵׁם שֶׁמַּקְדִּישִׁים אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מָרוֹם
lines.tl: N'kadeish et shimcha ba-olam k'sheim shemakdishim oto bishmei marom
lines.en: We will hallow Your Name in the world, as they hallow it in the heavens above
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כַּכָּתוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר
lines.tl: Kakatuv al yad n'vi-echa v'kara zeh el zeh v'amar
lines.en: As is written by the hand of Your prophet, And they called one to another, and said:
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ
lines.tl: Kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tz'va-ot m'lo chol ha-aretz k'vodo
lines.en: Holy, holy, holy, is Adonai of Hosts, the fullness of all the earth is His glory.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אַדִּיר אַדִּירֵנוּ, יְיָ אֲדוֹנֵינוּ, מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ
lines.tl: Adir adireinu, Adonai adoneinu, mah adir shimcha b'chol ha-aretz
lines.en: Mighty One, our Mighty One, Adonai our Lord, how mighty is Your name in all the earth!
lines.en_src: Original translation (Claude; draft for Jamie to check)

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְיָ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ
lines.tl: Baruch k'vod Adonai mim'komo
lines.en: Blessed is the glory of Adonai from its place
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֶחָד הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, הוּא אָבִינוּ, הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ, הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ, וְהוּא יַשְׁמִיעֵנוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו לְעֵינֵי כָּל חָי
lines.tl: Echad hu Eloheinu, hu avinu, hu malkeinu, hu moshi-einu, v'hu yashmi-einu b'rachamav l'einei kol chai
lines.en: One is our God: our Father, our King, our Deliverer, who in mercy will let us hear, before every living being:
lines.en_src: Original translation (Claude; draft for Jamie to check)

prayers.title: K'dushah (2)
