prayers.about: I am Adonai your God; God will reign forever; from generation to generation
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Kedushah (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 90: L'dor vador ends 'l'olam va-ed' and goes straight to the blessing (no 'ki El melech gadol v'kadosh atah').

lines.he: אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם
lines.tl: Ani Adonai Eloheichem
lines.en: I am Adonai your God.
lines.en_src: Original translation (Claude; draft for Jamie to check)

lines.he: יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ
lines.tl: Yimloch Adonai l'olam Elohayich Tziyon l'dor vador hal'luyah
lines.en: Adonai will reign forever; Your God, Zion, throughout all generations! Praise God.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נַגִּיד גָּדְלֶךָ וּלְנֵצַח נְצָחִים קְדֻשָּׁתְךָ נַקְדִּישׁ
lines.tl: L'dor vador nagid gadlecha ul'neitzach n'tzachim k'dushatcha nakdish
lines.en: From generation to generation we will declare Your greatness, and to all eternity, we will sanctify Your holiness
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְשִׁבְחֲךָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִפִּינוּ לֹא יָמוּשׁ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: V'shivchacha Eloheinu mipinu lo yamush l'olam va-ed
lines.en: And Your praise, our God, will not depart from our mouth forever and ever
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ha-eil hakadosh
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, the Almighty, the Holy One.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Yism'chu
prayers.about: Those who keep Shabbat rejoice: from the Shabbat morning Amidah
prayers.he_src: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Morning Services, Amidah (Torat Emet 357, Public Domain)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 92: same Hebrew words. CBB also prints Yismach Moshe and V'shamru here (said silently); V'shamru is in the Friday night unit.
Hebrew: Siddur Sefard (Torat Emet, public domain); English: Metsudah.

lines.he: יִשְׂמְחוּ בְמַלְכוּתְךָ שׁוֹמְרֵי שַׁבָּת וְקוֹרְאֵי עוֹנֶג עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי
lines.tl: Yism'chu v'malchutcha shomrei Shabbat v'kor'ei oneg am m'kad'shei sh'vi-i
lines.en: They shall rejoice in Your kingship— those who preserve the Sabbath and call it a delight. The people who sanctify the seventh [day]
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ
lines.tl: Kulam yisb'u v'yit'an'gu mituvecha
lines.en: Will all be satisfied and delighted from Your goodness.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי רָצִיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ
lines.tl: Uvash'vi-i ratzita bo v'kidashto
lines.en: And in the seventh [day], You took pleasure and You hallowed it.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: חֶמְדַת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָאתָ, זֵכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית
lines.tl: Chemdat yamim oto karata, zeicher l'ma-asei v'reishit
lines.en: “Most desirable of days,” You called it— a commemoration of the work of creation.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: R'tzeh
prayers.about: Be pleased with our prayer: the Amidah's blessing of worship (morning and evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Temple Service (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 96 (morning) and p. 44 (Friday night): same Hebrew words, including 'v'ishei Yisrael' (the fire-offerings), which some Reform siddurim change.
Then CBB continues with K'dushat HaYom's R'tzei vimnuchateinu (p. 93), which is in the Friday night unit.

lines.he: רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם
lines.tl: R'tzei Adonai Eloheinu b'am'cha Yisrael uvitfilatam
lines.en: Be pleased, Adonai, our God, with Your people, Israel, and their prayer
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ
lines.tl: V'hasheiv et ha-avodah lidvir beitecha
lines.en: And restore the service to the Holy of Holies in Your abode
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן
lines.tl: V'ishei Yisrael ut'filatam b'ahavah t'kabeil b'ratzon
lines.en: And the fire-offerings of Israel; and accept their prayer, lovingly and willingly.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ
lines.tl: Ut'hi l'ratzon tamid avodat Yisrael amecha
lines.en: And may You always find pleasure with the service of Your people, Israel.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים
lines.tl: V'techezenah eineinu b'shuvcha l'Tziyon b'rachamim
lines.en: And may our eyes behold Your merciful return to Zion.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai hamachazir sh'chinato l'Tziyon
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who returns His Divine Presence to Zion.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Modim
prayers.about: We give thanks: the Amidah's blessing of gratitude (morning and evening)
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Thanksgiving (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 98 and p. 46: same Hebrew words (the full Modim).

lines.he: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: Modim anachnu lach sha-atah hu Adonai Eloheinu v'Elohei avoteinu l'olam va-ed
lines.en: We are thankful to You that You Adonai are our God and the God of our fathers forever
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: צוּר חַיֵּינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
lines.tl: Tzur chayeinu magein yish'einu atah hu l'dor vador nodeh l'cha un'sapeir t'hilatecha
lines.en: Rock of our lives, You are the Shield of our deliverance in every generation. We will give thanks to You and recount Your praise
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: עַל־חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ
lines.tl: Al chayeinu ham'surim b'yadecha v'al nishmoteinu hap'kudot lach
lines.en: For our lives which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls which are entrusted to You
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם
lines.tl: V'al nisecha sheb'chol yom imanu v'al nifl'otecha v'tovotecha sheb'chol eit erev vavoker v'tzahorayim
lines.en: And for Your miracles of every day with us, and for Your wonders and benefactions at all times— evening, morning and noon.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ
lines.tl: Hatov ki lo chalu rachamecha
lines.en: You are The Beneficent One— for Your compassion is never withheld
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ
lines.tl: V'ham'racheim ki lo tamu chasadecha mei-olam kivinu lach
lines.en: And You are the Merciful One— for Your kindliness never ceases; we have always placed our hope in You.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
lines.tl: V'al kulam yitbarach v'yitromam shimcha malkeinu tamid l'olam va-ed
lines.en: And for all the foregoing may Your Name, our King, constantly be blessed and extolled, forever and ever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה
lines.tl: V'chol hachayim yoducha selah vihal'lu et shimcha be-emet ha-eil y'shu-ateinu v'ezrateinu selah
lines.en: And all the living shall thank You forever and praise Your Name with sincerity — the Almighty, Who is our deliverance and our help forever.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai hatov shimcha ul'cha na-eh l'hodot
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai; Your Name is The Beneficent and You it is fitting to praise.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Sim Shalom
prayers.about: Grant peace: the morning blessing for peace
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Amidah, Peace (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 100: same Hebrew words. Friday night has Shalom Rav instead.

lines.he: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ
lines.tl: Sim shalom tovah uv'rachah chein vachesed v'rachamim aleinu v'al kol Yisrael amecha
lines.en: Grant peace, goodness, and blessing, favor, kindness and compassion upon us and upon all Israel, Your people.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ
lines.tl: Barcheinu avinu kulanu k'echad b'or panecha
lines.en: Bless us, our Father, all of us as one with the light of Your countenance.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים
lines.tl: Ki v'or panecha natata lanu Adonai Eloheinu torat chayim
lines.en: For by the light of Your countenance You gave us Adonai our God, a Torah of life
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם
lines.tl: V'ahavat chesed utz'dakah uv'rachah v'rachamim v'chayim v'shalom
lines.en: And the love of kindliness, righteousness, blessing, compassion, life and peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ
lines.tl: V'tov b'einecha l'vareich et am'cha Yisrael b'chol eit uv'chol sha-ah bishlomecha
lines.en: And may it be good in Your sight to bless Your people, Israel, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם
lines.tl: Baruch atah Adonai ham'vareich et amo Yisrael bashalom
lines.en: Blessed are You, Adonai, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Yigdal (1)
prayers.about: A medieval song of the thirteen principles of faith: lines 1-7
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Yigdal (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 54: all 13 lines, sung responsively (leader, then congregation). Matched by transliteration.
By Daniel ben Judah (Rome, 14th c.), on Maimonides' 13 principles. Hebrew and English: Metsudah.

lines.he: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ
lines.tl: Yigdal Elohim chai v'yishtabach, nimtza v'ein eit el m'tzi-uto
lines.en: Exalted is the living God, and praised He exists, and His existence transcends time.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדּוּתוֹ
lines.tl: Echad v'ein yachid k'yichudo, nelam v'gam ein sof l'achduto
lines.en: He is One, and there is no unity like His, He is invisible, His unity is infinitive.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ
lines.tl: Ein lo d'mut haguf v'eino guf, lo na-aroch eilav k'dushato
lines.en: He is unlike the corporeal or even the non-corporeal, His holiness is beyond comparison.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ
lines.tl: Kadmon l'chol davar asher nivra, rishon v'ein reishit l'reishito
lines.en: He preceded every being that was created, He was First, and there was no genesis to His beginning.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ
lines.tl: Hino adon olam l'chol notzar, yoreh g'dulato umalchuto
lines.en: He is Master of the Universe to every creature, all proclaim His greatness and His majesty.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: שֶׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ
lines.tl: Shefa n'vu-ato n'tano, el anshei s'gulato v'tif'arto
lines.en: The fullness of His prophecy, He bestowed on those He treasured, and in whom He gloried.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת תְּמוּנָתוֹ
lines.tl: Lo kam b'Yisrael k'Moshe od, navi umabit et t'munato
lines.en: There never arose in Israel another like Moses, a prophet who beheld God's image.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Yigdal (2)
prayers.about: Yigdal, lines 8-13
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Yigdal (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 54: lines 8-13; the last line is sung by everyone.
Line 13 speaks of reviving the dead (meitim). Some Reform siddurim change it; CBB keeps it (transliteration).

lines.he: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ
lines.tl: Torat emet natan l'amo eil, al yad n'vi-o ne-eman beito
lines.en: The Torah of truth the Almighty gave to His people through His prophet, the trusted one of His house.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ
lines.tl: Lo yachalif ha-eil v'lo yamir dato, l'olamim l'zulato
lines.en: The Almighty will not exchange nor alter His Law. Never will He offer any alternative.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵעַ סְתָרֵינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמָתוֹ
lines.tl: Tzofeh v'yodeia s'tareinu, mabit l'sof davar b'kadmato
lines.en: He scrutinizes and knows our secrets. He beholds the end of a thing at its beginning.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רָע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ
lines.tl: Gomeil l'ish chesed k'mif'alo, notein l'rasha ra k'rish'ato
lines.en: He rewards man with kindness according to his deeds. He sends evil to the wicked according to his wickedness.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ
lines.tl: Yishlach l'keitz hayamin m'shicheinu, lifdot m'chakei keitz y'shu-ato
lines.en: He will send our Messiah at the end of days, to redeem all who await His final deliverance.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ
lines.tl: Meitim y'chayeh eil b'rov chasdo, baruch adei ad sheim t'hilato
lines.en: The Almighty will revive the dead because of His abundant kindness: Blessed forever is His praised Name.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Adon Olam
prayers.about: Master of the world: the closing song
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Adon Olam (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 124: all ten lines. Matched by transliteration.
Hebrew and English: Metsudah. CBB has its own English (p. 125).

lines.he: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא
lines.tl: Adon olam asher malach, b'terem kol y'tzir nivra
lines.en: Master of the Universe Who reigned before any creature was created.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא
lines.tl: L'eit na-asah v'cheftzo kol, azai melech sh'mo nikra
lines.en: At the time when all was made by His will, then was His Name proclaimed King.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא
lines.tl: V'acharei kichlot hakol, l'vado yimloch nora
lines.en: And after all things shall cease to be the Awesome One will reign alone.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה
lines.tl: V'hu hayah v'hu hoveh, v'hu yihyeh b'tif'arah
lines.en: He was, He is, and He shall be in glory.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּירָה
lines.tl: V'hu echad v'ein sheini, l'hamshil lo l'hachbirah
lines.en: He is One, and there is no second to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה
lines.tl: B'li reishit b'li tachlit, v'lo ha-oz v'hamisrah
lines.en: Without beginning, without end, power and dominion are His.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה
lines.tl: V'hu eili v'chai go-ali, v'tzur chevli b'eit tzarah
lines.en: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer, the Rock of my destiny in times of distress.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא
lines.tl: V'hu nisi umanos li, m'nat kosi b'yom ekra
lines.en: He is my flag and my refuge; He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה
lines.tl: B'yado afkid ruchi, b'eit ishan v'a-irah
lines.en: Into His hand I entrust my spirit [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְיָ לִי וְלֹא אִירָא
lines.tl: V'im ruchi g'viyati, Adonai li v'lo ira
lines.en: And with my spirit my body [too], Adonai is with me, I shall not fear.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

prayers.title: Ein Keloheinu
prayers.about: None like our God
prayers.he_src: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Korbanot (Israel), Ein Kelohenu (The Metsudah siddur, 1981, CC-BY)
check: CBB siddur Mashiv HaRuach p. 126: all five stanzas and the closing line about the incense (Atah hu shehiktiru...). Matched by transliteration.
Line 6 leaves out 'Adonai Eloheinu', which some editions add (CBB doesn't). English for line 6 is my own draft.

lines.he: אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵינוּ, אֵין כַּאדוֹנֵנוּ, אֵין כְּמַלְכֵּנוּ, אֵין כְּמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ
lines.tl: Ein keiloheinu, ein kadoneinu, ein k'malkeinu, ein k'moshi-einu
lines.en: There is none like our God. There is none like our Master. There is none like our King. There is none like our Deliverer.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: מִי כֵאלֹהֵינוּ, מִי כַאדוֹנֵנוּ, מִי כְמַלְכֵּנוּ, מִי כְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ
lines.tl: Mi cheiloheinu, mi chadoneinu, mi ch'malkeinu, mi ch'moshi-einu
lines.en: Who is like our God? Who is like our Master? Who is like our King? Who is like our Deliverer?
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: נוֹדֶה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ, נוֹדֶה לַאדוֹנֵנוּ, נוֹדֶה לְמַלְכֵּנוּ, נוֹדֶה לְמוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ
lines.tl: Nodeh leiloheinu, nodeh ladoneinu, nodeh l'malkeinu, nodeh l'moshi-einu
lines.en: Let us thank our God. Let us thank our Master. Let us thank our King. Let us thank our deliverer.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּרוּךְ אֲדוֹנֵנוּ בָּרוּךְ מַלְכֵּנוּ בָּרוּךְ מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ
lines.tl: Baruch Eloheinu baruch adoneinu baruch malkeinu baruch moshi-einu
lines.en: Blessed is our God. Blessed is our Master. Blessed is our King. Blessed is our Deliverer.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אַתָּה הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, אַתָּה הוּא אֲדוֹנֵנוּ, אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכֵּנוּ, אַתָּה הוּא מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ
lines.tl: Atah hu Eloheinu, atah hu adoneinu, atah hu malkeinu, atah hu moshi-einu
lines.en: You are our God. You are our Master. You are our King. You are our Deliverer.
lines.en_src: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981

lines.he: אַתָּה הוּא שֶׁהִקְטִרוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים
lines.tl: Atah hu shehiktiru avoteinu l'fanecha et k'toret hasamim
lines.en: You are the One before whom our ancestors burned the fragrant incense.
lines.en_src: Original translation (Claude; draft for Jamie to check)
